summary: Seattle, software engineer, strong interest in RISC-V architecture, advocates for universal basic income, supports legalizing and regulating all drugs, critical of corporate influence in politics, values transparency and accountability in government, emphasizes the importance of public infrastructure and urban planning, believes in the necessity of a social safety net, concerned about economic inequality, supports open-source software and community-driven projects, prefers data privacy and security, critical of the current education system and advocates for reform, interested in automation and its impact on society, values environmental sustainability, engaged in discussions about technology and its societal implications.
